51594665.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to PGC1alpha (unknown origin) by surface plasmon resonance assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: 4.12. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) assay SPR analyses to evaluate the interaction of 4-butyl-polyhydroxybenzophenone compounds with SIRT1 and PGC1α immobilized onto a CM5 sensor chip (Cytiva, BR100530, Shanghai, China) were performed using a Biacore T200 apparatus (Cytiva, Sweden) at 25 °C. During the analyte-ligand interaction, the change of the refractive index was measured in real-time which allowed to plot the results of interaction as response units (RU) versus time (one RU represents the binding of 1 pg of protein per square mm).
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Predicted binding modes of 6 compounds (Y2, Y4, Y9, D2, S2, S9) with SIRT1 or PGC1α. (A) Docking results of 6 compounds with SIRT1 (PDB: 4ZZI) or PGC1α (PDB: 3CS8). Y2: green; Y4: red; Y9: orange; D2: cyan; S2: magenta; S9: blue. (B) SPR analysis of the interaction between compounds and SIRT1 or PGC1α. Left: SPR analysis of 6 compounds interacting with SIRT1 or PGC1α. Middle: SPR analysis of S2 interacting with SIRT1 or PGC1α. Right: The representative binding curve. (C) S2 protected SIRT1 or PGC1α against proteolysis in DARTS assays. (D-E) CETSA-WB experiment to further confirm that S2 binding with SIRT1 or PGC1α.
original_paragraph.SPR Analysis from Figure 3B: The SPR analysis of 6 compounds interacting with SIRT1 or PGC1α is shown in Figure 3B. The left panel shows the sensorgrams for the interaction of 6 compounds with SIRT1 (top) and PGC1α (bottom). The middle panel shows the sensorgrams for the interaction of S2 with SIRT1 (top) and PGC1α (bottom) at different concentrations (3.9, 7.8, 15.6, 31.3, 62.5, 125, 250, 500 μmol/L). The right panel shows the representative binding curve for S2 with SIRT1 and PGC1α, with the x-axis labeled as 'S2 concentration (μmol/L)' and the y-axis as 'Response (RU)'. The curves show a concentration-dependent increase in response, reaching a steady state. The KD values were 77.31 μmol/L for SIRT1 and 171.8 μmol/L for PGC1α.
original_paragraph.Results Section: To detect their binding activities, the SPR technique was used. Notably, 6 (Y2, Y4, Y9, D2, S2, S9) compounds all showed affinity with SIRT1 and PGC1α (Fig. 3B left). As shown in Fig. 3B middle, the interactions between S2 (the highest binding activities) and SIRT1 or PGC1α were concentration dependent. Fig. 3B middle also indicated that the interactions reached a steady state rapidly upon injection, as well as rapid dissociation from the binding site. The KD values were 77.31 μmol/L for SIRT1 and 171.8 μmol/L for PGC1α.

analyte.description: 4-butyl-polyhydroxybenzophenone compounds (including Y2, Y4, Y9, D2, S2, S9)
